entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?
I need to return some shoes. Order number is VF88-1092-B.

Okay, I can certainly look into that for you. Pulling up VF88-1092-B now. I see an order for our Pro-Series cycling shoes. To make sure I understand correctly, what specifically is the issue with them? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
They don't fit. I wore them a few times and they gave me terrible blisters. I also could never get the cleats to feel right. I just want a refund.
I'm very sorry to hear about the blisters, that's definitely not the experience we want for our customers. Let me just confirm the purchase date. One moment...
Just tell me yes or no. Can I return them?
Yes, absolutely. I see here the delivery was 84 days ago, and our policy for standard items like these cycling shoes is 90 days. You're well within the window.

I've just approved the return in our system. I'm sending a pre-paid return label to the email on file right now. Just box them up, attach the label, and drop it at any post office. Once our warehouse scans it, the full refund will be processed back to your card.
Okay, that's perfect. Simple. Thank you.
You're very welcome. And since you're a VIP member with us, I've also gone ahead and added a $25 credit to your account for the trouble. You can use that on any future VeloFit purchase.
Oh. I appreciate that. Thanks, Diana.
Of course. Was there anything else I could assist you with today?
Great. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
